## Checklist

- [ ] `python -m pytest tests` passes locally (or CI is green)
- [ ] Tried in Blender 4.5 LTS **or** 5.x headless or desktop (say which)
- [ ] New behaviour has a test, or the PR says why it cannot
- [ ] Exported files validate against the X3D 4.0 schema (if the change touches export)
- [ ] `blender_manifest.toml` version bumped if this is a user-visible change
- [ ] No files outside the scope of this PR were reformatted
